source.title: Precalculus: A Unit Circle Approach, 4th edition

concepts.title: 双曲线的标准式与作图
concepts.summary: 两焦距之差的绝对值为 $2a$，且 $c^2=a^2+b^2$。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 配方归一化；正项所在变量确定实轴。中心 $(h,k)$；实轴半长 $a$，共轭半长 $b$。水平实轴渐近线 $y-k=\pm(b/a)(x-h)$，垂直实轴则 $y-k=\pm(a/b)(x-h)$。

pitfalls: $a$ 不一定比 $b$ 大；不能把双曲线的加法关系误作椭圆的减法。

en.title: Standard equations and graphs of hyperbolas
en.summary: The absolute difference of focal distances is $2a$, and $c^2=a^2+b^2$.

method.title: Method
method.body: Complete squares and normalize. The positive squared term determines the transverse axis. For center $(h,k)$ use $y-k=\pm(b/a)(x-h)$ for a horizontal transverse axis and $y-k=\pm(a/b)(x-h)$ for a vertical one.

pitfalls: $a$ need not exceed $b$; use the hyperbola relation with a plus sign.

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先统一长度和时间单位；设焦点为接收器/发射器位置，用已知先后确定所需分支；多组信号取全部符合原距离条件的交点。

en.title: Distance differences and location
en.summary: Speed times the arrival-time difference equals $2a$, not $a$.

method.title: Method
method.body: Use consistent length and time units. Put the receivers/transmitters at the foci, select the branch using arrival order, and retain all intersections satisfying the original distances.

concepts.title: 离心率、通径、切线及退化

method.title: 方法
method.body: 焦点处代入标准式求通径；切线用重根/梯度核验。二次式配方后需另分相交直线、点和空集。

en.title: Eccentricity, latus rectum, tangents, and degeneration

method.title: Method
method.body: Substitute a focus coordinate to find the latus rectum; verify tangents by a repeated root or gradient. Completing squares also reveals intersecting lines, a point, or the empty set.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 配方并除以常数，得标准式 $\frac{x^{2}}{4} - \frac{y^{2}}{10} = 1$。中心为 $\left( 0, \  0\right)$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 正项决定实轴方向；实轴方程 $y = 0$。$a^2=4,\ b^2=10,\ c^2=a^2+b^2=14$。顶点 $\left( \left( -2, \  0\right), \  \left( 2, \  0\right)\right)$，焦点 $\left( \left( - \sqrt{14}, \  0\right), \  \left( \sqrt{14}, \  0\right)\right)$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 基本矩形四顶点为 $\left( \left( -2, \  - \sqrt{10}\right), \  \left( -2, \  \sqrt{10}\right), \  \left( 2, \  - \sqrt{10}\right), \  \left( 2, \  \sqrt{10}\right)\right)$；渐近线为 $y-0=\pm \frac{\sqrt{10}}{2}(x-0)$。双曲线从顶点向左右延伸并趋近两条渐近线。

en.prompt: Does $x^2/4-y^2/10=1$ have its transverse axis on the x-axis or y-axis?

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Complete the squares and divide by the constant to obtain $\frac{x^{2}}{4} - \frac{y^{2}}{10} = 1$. The center is $\left( 0, \  0\right)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The positive squared term determines the transverse axis $y = 0$; $a^2=4,\ b^2=10,\ c^2=a^2+b^2=14$. Vertices: $\left( \left( -2, \  0\right), \  \left( 2, \  0\right)\right)$; foci: $\left( \left( - \sqrt{14}, \  0\right), \  \left( \sqrt{14}, \  0\right)\right)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The fundamental rectangle has corners $\left( \left( -2, \  - \sqrt{10}\right), \  \left( -2, \  \sqrt{10}\right), \  \left( 2, \  - \sqrt{10}\right), \  \left( 2, \  \sqrt{10}\right)\right)$. The asymptotes are $y-0=\pm \frac{\sqrt{10}}{2}(x-0)$. The two branches open left and right from the vertices and approach the asymptotes.

en.label: Example 1

questions.prompt: 求双曲线 $28y^2-36x^2=63$ 的顶点与焦点。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 配方并除以常数，得标准式 $- \frac{4 x^{2}}{7} + \frac{4 y^{2}}{9} = 1$。中心为 $\left( 0, \  0\right)$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 正项决定实轴方向；实轴方程 $x = 0$。$a^2=\frac{9}{4},\ b^2=\frac{7}{4},\ c^2=a^2+b^2=4$。顶点 $\left( \left( 0, \  - \frac{3}{2}\right), \  \left( 0, \  \frac{3}{2}\right)\right)$，焦点 $\left( \left( 0, \  -2\right), \  \left( 0, \  2\right)\right)$。

questions.answer: $- \frac{4 x^{2}}{7} + \frac{4 y^{2}}{9} = 1$；中心 $\left( 0, \  0\right)$；顶点 $\left( \left( 0, \  - \frac{3}{2}\right), \  \left( 0, \  \frac{3}{2}\right)\right)$；焦点 $\left( \left( 0, \  -2\right), \  \left( 0, \  2\right)\right)$；渐近线 $y-0=\pm \frac{3 \sqrt{7}}{7}(x-0)$。

questions.prompt: 中心为 $(0,0)$，求方程：(a) 焦点 $(\pm5,0)$，渐近线 $y=\pm2x$；(b) 顶点 $(0,\pm1)$，渐近线 $y=\pm x/2$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) $a^2=5,\ c^2=25,\ b^2=c^2-a^2=20$；(b) $a^2=1,\ c^2=5,\ b^2=c^2-a^2=4$。先由顶点、焦点或渐近线斜率求这些长度，再代入对应实轴方向的标准式。

steps.title: 计算与推导

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 令符号 $s=\pm1$，移项并平方得 $4cx=4a^2+4sa\sqrt{(x-c)^2+y^2}$，故 $cx-a^2=sa\sqrt{(x-c)^2+y^2}$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 再次平方：$c^2x^2-2ca^2x+a^4=a^2(x^2-2cx+c^2+y^2)$，交叉线性项抵消。

en.prompt: Derive the standard equation from $\sqrt{(x+c)^2+y^2}-\sqrt{(x-c)^2+y^2}=\pm2a$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Put $s=\pm1$. Isolate one radical and square: $4cx=4a^2+4sa\sqrt{(x-c)^2+y^2}$, so $cx-a^2=sa\sqrt{(x-c)^2+y^2}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Square again: $c^2x^2-2ca^2x+a^4=a^2(x^2-2cx+c^2+y^2)$; the linear cross terms cancel.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Rearrange to $(c^2-a^2)x^2-a^2y^2=a^2(c^2-a^2)$. Put $b^2=c^2-a^2>0$ and divide by $a^2b^2$.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (i) $A,C>0$：$R>0$ 为椭圆（$A=C$ 为圆），$R=0$ 为中心一点，$R<0$ 空集。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (ii) $A>0,C<0$：$R>0$ 为水平实轴双曲线，$R<0$ 为垂直实轴双曲线；$R=0$ 为两条相交直线。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (iii) $A<0,C>0$：$R>0$ 为垂直实轴双曲线，$R<0$ 为水平实轴双曲线；$R=0$ 仍为两条相交直线。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (iv) $A,C<0$：$R<0$ 为椭圆（$A=C$ 为圆），$R=0$ 为中心一点，$R>0$ 空集。

en.prompt: Discuss $Ax^2+Cy^2+Dx+Ey+F=0$, $AC\ne0$, after completing squares, for (i) $A,C>0$; (ii) $A>0,C<0$; (iii) $A<0,C>0$; (iv) $A,C<0$, including the effect of the constant’s sign.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The center is $h=-D/(2A),k=-E/(2C)$, and completing squares gives $A(x-h)^2+C(y-k)^2=R$, where $R=D^2/(4A)+E^2/(4C)-F$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (i) $A,C>0$: $R>0$ gives an ellipse (circle if $A=C$), $R=0$ gives the center point, and $R<0$ gives the empty set.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (ii) $A>0,C<0$: $R>0$ gives a horizontal transverse axis; $R<0$ a vertical one; $R=0$ gives intersecting lines.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (iii) $A<0,C>0$: $R>0$ gives a vertical transverse axis; $R<0$ a horizontal one; $R=0$ gives intersecting lines.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (iv) $A,C<0$: $R<0$ gives an ellipse (circle if $A=C$), $R=0$ gives the center point, and $R>0$ gives the empty set.

steps.body: 实际核查：短链重定向至 Pearson 的 uc4rmw_8_4_interactive.html，最终 HTTP 404；无法验证实时初值和操作反馈。以下只给一般关系，不虚构运行结果。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) 中心 $C=(h,k)$，从C到P的距离为 $a>0$，从C到Q的距离为 $b>0$。水平实轴时方程 $(x-h)^2/a^2-(y-k)^2/b^2=1$；垂直实轴交换正负变量项。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) 重新计算 $a=|CP|$ 后，$c=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$，焦点为 $(h\pm c,k)$ 或 $(h,k\pm c)$。P“左移一单位”后的变化取决于初始方向和位置，不能在缺少初值时固定说增减多少。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (c) 移C平移中心；改变P调实轴半长，改变Q调共轭半长；每次重算 $c$ 和正确方向的渐近线。必须保持 $a,b>0$，零值是退化边界。

exercises.answer: 可完成一般关系分析；外部互动的初始状态和实时反馈未作为已验证答案。 原互动链接最终返回 HTTP 404。

en.prompt: Open https://bit.ly/3wuunoM: (a) Drag center C, vertex P, and conjugate-axis endpoint Q and observe the equation, foci, and asymptotes. (b) Display then hide the foci, move P one unit left, and compare. (c) Continue experimenting with C, P, and Q.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The short link was checked and redirects to Pearson’s uc 4 rmw_8_4_interactive.html, which returns HTTP 404. Its live initial state and interaction feedback cannot be verified. Only general relationships are supplied; no applet results are invented.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) Let $C=(h,k)$, $a=|CP|>0$, and $b=|CQ|>0$. With a horizontal transverse axis the equation is $(x-h)^2/a^2-(y-k)^2/b^2=1$; exchange the positive and negative variable terms for a vertical transverse axis.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) Recompute $a=|CP|$ after the move, then $c=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$. Foci are $(h\pm c,k)$ or $(h,k\pm c)$. Moving P left one unit changes values according to its initial location and orientation; no fixed numerical change follows without those initial values.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (c) Moving C translates the center; moving P adjusts the transverse semilength, and moving Q the conjugate semilength. Recompute $c$ and the orientation-specific asymptotes each time. Maintain $a,b>0$; zero is a degenerate boundary.

en.answer: General relationships are supplied; the external activity’s initial state and live feedback are not claimed as verified answers. The original interactive link returns HTTP 404.
